title: 実直！ 実験！ 実証！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One afternoon…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Calling out to me like this… Are you finally confessing? The culprit in the explosion the other day was actually you, wasn't it, Tachyon?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No such thing. I just have a favor to ask you today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: As class representative and a model student, you're the only one I can ask!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Is that so? Ehehe! In that case, go ahead and ask away!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Haha! I'm glad you're honest and dependable! Okay, take a look at that clock over there.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It emits unique radio waves that are similar yet different to regular ones, and it uses the brain as a type of receiver. This affects the pineal gland, producing melatonin…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Err?! Unique… radio… mela?! What?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In other words! You're being bombarded by intense drowsiness. But I want you to harness it for your growth!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Growth? I see! In that case, it's time for the class representative to shine! I'll show this drowsiness who's bo…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hypnosis successful. Now for the next phase… Look around, you're doing a light jog along the beach at night, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh! Yes! My legs are so light! It almost feels like I'm running on air!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? Then start doing that, run into the sky… Surpass your limits! Soar across the horizon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll… surpass my limits!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: OHHH?! I did it! I'm blasting through the sky!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what on earth am I doing? Where did the beach go?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay! It's time for the big reveal! …Class Rep, the culprit who blew up the classroom the other day was none other than… me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What did you say?! Not once, but twice? The classroom is sacred, and you'd dare blow it up?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I've caught you now, Tachyon! I'll get you with ease!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: As I thought, there's a noticeable change in your gait! My pretend getaway provided us with all the evidence we need!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My performance-enhancing-hypnosis hypothesis was correct!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O's running somehow got better!
